request.intent: Determine the ideal distribution of which output mode contains the photon. The input is one photon in mode 0 and none in mode 1; the two-mode circuit is coherent and lossless. R(t) = [[cos(t), -sin(t)], [sin(t), cos(t)]]. First R(a), next a phase exp(i*phi) on mode 1, last R(b); parameters are radians.
